comparison.objective: Remove steel and electronics from a patient cart before MRI entry, not adjust an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Identification, grasping, and removal of prohibited items versus tool-mediated fine adjustment and force-controlled locking.
comparison.success_condition: Cart cleared of steel/electronics; body only names the task directory, with no spec versions or detailed completeness/safety rubric. Candidate requires two measured safe cycles and setting retention.
comparison.reason: Object clearing and classification do not test calibration, impact response, or retained adjustment.
